notes.title: Complete sound/audio rework.
notes.notes:
A surprise update for our adorable residents. Reworked the audio/sound completely from scratch to give the game a new atmosphere. On the other hand, there were few bugs and crash related issues addressed as well. 

Want to thank to all the people who reached out to me, and share their excitement about the game, questions and positive messages! You're the best and I'm utterly glad you've had a great time. Thank you.

- Complete sound rework.
- Bug Fixes

notes.title: We actually made it! Patch is LIVE
notes.notes:
That was close, we've made it on time!

All the work on Stay Close and Testing were just finalized minutes ago! That wouldn't be possible without the contribution of our new programmer who managed to finish all the tasks!

Stay Close is much more optimized now! Loads 2-3 times faster than before, as well as lot of minor bugs were eliminated. Previously stated in the announcement before there was a lot of changes, including new A.I and level design. 

The patch is a big deal, because provides us a really good foundation to build and implement more to the game without worrying the issues will stack. 

Hope you'll enjoy it! I can't wait to stalk new videos on YouTube and Twitch! 

Next patch will include new animations, sounds and maybe expanded level design. 

Great Summer, residents!

notes.title: Patchnotes for 1.05.4.2
notes.notes:
Misc: 
- Fix: Critical bug where a player could get a disconnect or get stuck after death

Map:
- Fix: Fool message at the end of the city was not visible

---------
We're sorry for the delay of this patch, took some time to recreate and fix the disconnect issue.
Please note that there could be some visual problems for the connected player at the first few seconds of the game, but they're gone as soon as the game is starting.
With the critical bug fixed, we are working on patches to fix the smaller bugs - releasing in the upcoming days!
If you experience any bugs, feel free to report them in our forum. Thank you!

ᅠᅠᅠᅠᅠᅠᅠᅠ[b]Hey “Stay Close” community!



The 3rd day of the release is wrapping up in few hours and I wanted to share some words with you. 

It was quite the storm of excitement. We had crazy amount of feedback, both good and bad.

Before I continue, I want to make something clear. Stay Close is our baby and we gonna make it a great experience.

I’ve seen people enjoy Stay Close less in single-player, that’s pretty reasonable because the direction of the game was co-op, the single-player option was included as respect towards the lone-wolves, so they’re not disappointed, awh well. 

The first week Stay Close was released at -34%, because we knew there’s going to be bugs and things to fix/tweak. However they will be addressed until the end of the week. Good job to these brave players!
[/b]

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
Hello guys,
just a quick message by reviewing the feedback of the last hours after the release.
First of all, thank you for your feedback. It's fun to see people enjoying our game, may it on YouTube, Twitch, or just your messages.
And, of course, we are reading the negative feedback of the people who did not like it, too.
We are taking your feedback serious, and we are going to change and fix different things in the next days and weeks.

If you have any ideas on how the game can be made even more enjoyable, please make a thread in our discussion boards and let us know.
You can be sure we will read as much of the feedback as we can.

If you enjoy our game, please write, if possible, a positiv review on our store page, thank you!
If you did not, we're sorry to hear that. But we would like to know why, so we can improve the game.

There will be various patches coming in the next days and weeks, so be sure to head back. :)

Thank you and have fun with our game!

notes.title: Why we don't release the game?
notes.notes:
Hello community!

Want to thank you for the incredible support!

The most interested folks, following the progress of Stay Close noticed the game has some delays! 

That's due to fixing glitches and make sure not to disappoint the community with our game. 

It's really exciting to see many people who can't see the game out, and we know how bad it could be to keep waiting for something you want, however it's for the greater good to fix all issues before release so you have a nice time playing!

Best wishes,
Neko!
